ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "U.S. - Central America a Transnational Perspective." Examines how populations are criminalized due to race/ethnicity, gender, sexuality, class, and immigration status. Readings analyze why youth join gangs? Where the gangs originated? What are the relationships between U.S. security policies, neoliberalism, violence, and migration? To effectively engage in critical inquiry, students will be asked to suspend moral judgments so that they can analytically approach the study of criminalized populations, criminals, and criminal activity.
